events.title: Release Date Announcement
events.summary: Hello everyone! At long last, I am ready to announce the release date for Starshapes, so here it is!Starshapes releases on November 4th 2026 at 18:00 CET / 09:00 PST on Steam! The Original Soundtrack for Starshapes will also be available to purchase at the same time as the main game will release!Thank you for your patience all these years and for checking out the demo and all the feedback! I hope you look forward to the release day as much as I do!-Peter
